title: fix(rest)!: mount the restriction profile on the unscoped base only
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9JpRoUZGqtwqMU5k7b4C58D)_

Fixes #36198

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — an anonymous route is removed from scoped hosts; owes one contract-review-tier review before the queue
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill and no docs page names the environment-scoped restriction-profile path (zero hits for the route under `skills/`, `content/docs/`, `ui/`, `examples/` and `apps/`), and the unscoped route is unchanged

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：开启了环境隔离的部署，原来多出来的按环境“限制档”匿名地址现在访问会得到“未找到”，主地址和上线前校验都照旧，普通用户无感。
- 为什么做：那个地址对任何环境都回答“什么都允许”，而云端实际并不允许，又没有任何工具在读它，这是替云端托管环境撤掉一条与事实不符的公开信息。
- 出错会怎样：如果有外部工具已经在读那个按环境的地址，它会读不到，改读主地址即可，这个改动本身可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

Ruling: maintainer ruling C on the card, recorded in comment `7077639745` (unmount the environment-scoped twin; no new seam, contract, redirect or loopback).

- **The route.** `registerDiscoveryEndpoints` (`packages/rest/src/discovery-routes.ts`) registers `GET {basePath}/discovery/restriction-profile` on the unscoped base only. It reuses the registrar's own `isScoped` reading, the one `/discovery` already branches on; no flag is added. Under `api.enableProjectScoping`, `GET {basePath}/environments/:environmentId/discovery/restriction-profile` is no longer mounted and meets the host's ordinary not-found answer. The unscoped route is the same handler, body and empty query set as before, and a host's own route on that path still wins by mount order.
- **A consequence, stated.** `api.projectResolution: 'required'` registers the scoped base alone, so such a server now mounts no restriction-profile route. Before this change it served the profile only on the scoped path, which the one reader, `os validate --target`, never read (it fetches the unscoped route at the URL's origin).
- **Text this change made false, corrected here.** Three files beyond the claimed file surface, each comment or prose only (the acceptance notes give the reason and the way to drop them):
  - `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`: the `registerRoutes` docblock, which ships in the package's declarations, said both bases carry the routes; it now names the one exception and the `required` consequence.
  - `packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts`: the header said every row is mirrored under the scoped base; it now names the one exception, and so does the row's `note`.
  - `scripts/adr-anchors/packages__rest__src__discovery-routes.ts.json`: the file's invariant said every route in it is mounted once per base.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/36198-restriction-profile-unscoped-only.md`: `@objectstack/rest` `patch`, with the breaking notice, the ADR-0087 disposition and the one-line remedy.
- **Not in this PR: ADR-0138.** No file under `docs/adr/` changes. The record's D2 note of 2026-11-20 still names the twin; the acceptance notes give the sentence and its replacement for the weekly ADR revisions card.

**Read first** (by risk):

1. `packages/rest/src/discovery-routes.ts`. The whole behaviour change is the `if (!isScoped)` guard around one registration; the handler inside is re-indented and otherwise untouched (`git diff -w` shows the guard, its closing brace and comments only).
2. `packages/rest/src/discovery-schema-conformance.test.ts`. The existing `[#34774]` suite pinned "both mounts", the branch this PR removes, so it is reworked to drive the unscoped route with and without the scoped base beside it; the `[#36198]` suite is new.
3. `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`, one docblock hunk: the sentence that a `required` server does not serve the profile is the consequence above, stated on a published declaration.

**Two-minute check.** Run `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2 src/discovery-schema-conformance.test.ts` after building the package's dependencies. Expect `Tests  28 passed (28)`, four of them under `[#36198] the restriction profile is mounted on the unscoped base only`.

## Tests

Test readings are at head `9398ea17f`; the gate readings under Verification are at `21b1caaeb`. The note that closes this section says what separates the two heads and why the tests were not run again. All of it was measured in one container shared with other agents.

- **The pin** (`[#36198]`, four cases, in the file that already holds the route's harness):
  - `auto` and `optional`: the scoped path has no registration in `getRoutes()`, in the route manager, or on the host's `IHttpServer`, under any of five verbs; the unscoped path is registered as `GET`. Control: the scoped `/discovery` is registered on the same server, so the absence is read from a populated mount.
  - `required`: neither path is registered. Controls: scoped `/discovery` is, unscoped `/discovery` is not.
  - On the wire, through the real `HonoHttpServer` router: the scoped path answers `404` with no profile, the unscoped route answers `200` with a value that parses as `RestrictionProfileSchema`. Control: scoped `/discovery` answers `200` on that router.
- **Ablation** (one behaviour, the guard). Predicted before the run: the four `[#36198]` cases turn red and the `[#34774]` cases stay green. Observed: exactly that.

<details><summary>Ablation log: guard replaced by an always-true condition, then restored</summary>

```text
ablation-replace: anchor   "if (!isScoped) {"  x1 (before)
ablation-replace: ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob 603d815fa133 -> b59f2ad908ef
 × [#36198] ... > auto: the scoped base carries no restriction-profile route, and the unscoped route stays
 × [#36198] ... > optional: the scoped base carries no restriction-profile route, and the unscoped route stays
 × [#36198] ... > required: only the scoped base is mounted, so no restriction-profile route is
 × [#36198] ... > on the wire: the scoped path meets the not-found answer, and the unscoped route answers the profile
   AssertionError: expected 200 to be 404          (the wire case: the twin answered again)
 Test Files  1 failed (1)
      Tests  4 failed | 24 passed (28)
ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (603d815fa133) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```

The subject is imported by relative path from `src/`, so no build sits between the mutation and the run. The mutation and the restore are both proven on disk by the tool (anchor count, blob hash, empty `git diff HEAD`).
</details>

- **Package suite.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files  427 passed (427)`, `Tests  8783 passed | 351 skipped (9134)`, lock verdict `command-exit 0`.
- **Type check.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit` and the test-layer check): `check:test-typecheck: OK`, lock verdict `command-exit 0`. An earlier round was red on one `TS2345` in the new pin's helper (a plain string handed to the route manager's method parameter); the helper now carries the method literals.
- **Composed probe, not committed.** The REST plugin and the dispatcher plugin on a real Hono listener (`LiteKernel`, scoping on), read over HTTP at a still earlier head, `5dc651919`; `git diff -w 5dc651919 21b1caaeb -- packages/rest/src/discovery-routes.ts` shows comment lines only.

<details><summary>Probe readings</summary>

```text
auto      GET /api/v1/discovery/restriction-profile                          -> 200 success:true allowCode:true
auto      GET /api/v1/environments/env_alpha/discovery/restriction-profile   -> 404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND
auto      GET /api/v1/environments/probe/discovery/restriction-profile       -> 404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND
auto      GET /api/v1/environments/env_alpha/discovery                       -> 200   (control: the scoped base answers)
required  GET /api/v1/discovery/restriction-profile                          -> 404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND
required  GET /api/v1/environments/env_alpha/discovery/restriction-profile   -> 404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND
required  GET /api/v1/environments/env_alpha/discovery                       -> 200   (control)
```

This is a test kernel with the two plugins that own `/api/v1` routing, not a provisioned product host; the hosted reading on the card (cloud's composed host) was not re-measured here.
</details>

- **Dogfood battery** (owed: the title carries `!` and the claim carries the `(narrowing)` arm). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, no shard, no path, after building the dogfood dependency closure (`Tasks: 70 successful, 70 total`).

NOT MEASURED locally. The full run was started at head `9398ea17f` and stopped on the dispatching seat's instruction after 4829 s (lock verdict `command-exit 143`): it had held the container's one shared verify lock for 80 minutes and other agents' runs were timing out behind it. CI runs the battery.

<details><summary>What the stopped run had shown, and the by-path run that could not be taken</summary>

At the stop, 11 files had reported a failure, 17 cases in all, each lasting between 5.0 s and 7.2 s. That is the shape of the 5 s default test timeout on a loaded box, but the run printed no error text before it stopped, so the reading is unconfirmed. None of the 11 names discovery, an environment-scoped route, the restriction profile or a scoping option (0 hits each for those words):

```text
test/approval-flow-name-per-namespace.dogfood.test.ts
test/email-template-override-unshipped-locale.dogfood.test.ts
test/external-validate-sees-runtime-save.dogfood.test.ts
test/flow-undeclared-cycle-publish.dogfood.test.ts
test/object-designer-field-reorder.dogfood.test.ts
test/object-hook-lifecycle-showcase.dogfood.test.ts
test/object-unknown-datasource-refusal.dogfood.test.ts
test/permission-unknown-grant-object-refusal.dogfood.test.ts
test/rest-route-generation-tombstones.test.ts
test/seed-external-id-refusal.dogfood.test.ts
test/studio-zh-cn-echo-publish.dogfood.test.ts
```

Six dogfood files read what this diff changes (they import the REST route ledger from source, read `rest-server.ts` or `discovery-routes.ts`, or classify the restriction-profile route): `anonymous-door-sweep.dogfood`, `authz-conformance`, `authz-probe-blind-spot`, `discovery-auth-families.dogfood`, `hook-error-format.dogfood` and `route-ledger-live-mount-parity.dogfood`. None of them is among the 11. A by-path run of the six at the final head is NOT MEASURED, for the reason the next paragraph gives.
</details>

**What was not run again at the final head, and why.** Three commits follow `9398ea17f`. One restores the ADR file to `main`'s bytes; the other two re-word comments, one docblock, one ledger `note` string, the anchor JSON and the changeset title. `git diff 9398ea17f 21b1caaeb -- packages/rest/src` changes no executable line: comment lines, and the content of that one string literal. The pin, the ablation, the package suite and the type check above were measured at `9398ea17f` and are NOT MEASURED at `21b1caaeb`. Every build and test in this container goes through one shared verify lock, and after the stop this run queued on it for 12 consecutive 540 s budgets (about 108 minutes) without an acquisition; in that time the lock was granted 7 times across all agents. CI's `Test Core` runs the package suite on this head. The `dist` of `@objectstack/rest` in this container is the build at `9398ea17f`, so one `registerRoutes` docblock sentence in it carries the earlier wording.

## Acceptance notes

- **The scoped mount never shipped in a published release.** The route and its twin arrived together in the change whose changeset, `.changeset/34774-restriction-profile-route.md`, is still pending; `packages/rest/CHANGELOG.md` has zero hits for the route (control: the CLI changelog has eight for the profile), and the last version commit (`958ee0359`, 2026-11-18) is an ancestor of the commit that added the route (`f5cfdd21f`, 2026-11-21), `merge-base --is-ancestor` exit 0. So the narrowing is against `main`, which cloud pins by commit, not against any npm version. The claim's `Clause-②` line is copied as written; the seat may want to re-read it against this.
- **Changeset migration text.** The body carries the before and after answers and a one-line remedy as prose, not a labelled rewrite block: no key, export or stored value moves, so the disposition is `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, which the ADR-0087 gate refuses beside a rewrite block. The gate's reading: `1 declared-breaking changeset(s), each carrying an ADR-0087 disposition`.
- **ADR-0138 D2 is now out of step with the code, by design of the process.** An implementation card's file surface carries no `docs/adr/` path, so the record's text moves through the weekly ADR revisions card (#36086), not here. An earlier commit on this branch (`858d9fc24`) edited the record; `b6b796c18` restores the file to `main`'s bytes, and `git diff origin/main...HEAD --stat -- docs/adr` is empty.
  - Says (D2, the note "Amended 2026-11-20"): "`GET {basePath}/discovery/restriction-profile`, and its environment-scoped twin `GET {basePath}/environments/:environmentId/discovery/restriction-profile` where environment scoping mounts it."
  - True after this PR: the route is `GET {basePath}/discovery/restriction-profile` alone. The twin is not mounted; a request to it gets the host's ordinary not-found answer; a server that mounts the scoped base alone (`projectResolution: 'required'`) serves no restriction profile. Authority: ruling C on this card, comment `7077639745`.
- **Three files beyond the claimed surface.** The claim names `discovery-routes.ts`, its tests and the changeset. The three prose corrections listed under What changes are statements this change made false; the `registerRoutes` docblock among them ships in `dist/index.d.ts`. None changes behaviour, and of the re-worded passages only that docblock reaches the built output (a search of `dist/index.js`, `index.cjs`, `index.d.ts` and `index.d.cts`: the docblock sentence is in all four, the ledger header, the ledger note and the registrar comments in none). They sit apart from the route change, so dropping them is `git checkout origin/main -- packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts scripts/adr-anchors/packages__rest__src__discovery-routes.ts.json` and one commit, which leaves those three statements false on `main`.
- **Cloud.** Cloud's anonymous-surface ledger still carries a row for the twin (cloud's change, not touched here).
- **Observation, not filed.** In the probe's `required` composition `GET /api/v1/discovery` was answered by the dispatcher plugin's enveloped document. That is a reading about a test kernel, with no product door measured.
- **Landing.** No governed path is in the diff (`dispatch-gates.mjs` tier line: `no path-derived mandate: the surface hits none of the 4 declared glob(s)`). The narrowing owes one contract-review-tier review before the queue. No reviewer is requested by this PR.

## Verification

- Gate list derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` from the change set (6 paths, 204 changed lines, +172 / -32, against merge base `59392ed1d`): 82 commands, exit code captured before any pipe. 81 exit 0. Not exit 0: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, read as NOT MEASURED: eight published packages outside this PR's build closure have no `dist` in this container; CI's `Build Core` runs it). 67 of them ran with the tree at `21b1caaeb`; the other 15 ran at `253d6675a`, one commit earlier, and read neither of the two files that commit changed (the derivation run on those two paths does not name them). `--ran` reconciliation: `83 derived, 81 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 1 UNRUN`. The one UNRUN family is `pnpm check:type-check-debt`, NOT MEASURED here: it takes the same verify lock for its own closure build. One gate was red on the way: `pnpm check:doc-authoring` at `253d6675a`, on a tracker id this branch had put in the ledger row's `note` string; `21b1caaeb` removes it and the gate exits 0.
- CI: this body is written once, when the PR is opened, so no check-run exists yet to cite; the dev report on the card carries the check-run reading taken after the open.
- `origin/main` was merged into the branch at `59392ed1d`. At the open it stood at `2da297972`, 22 commits ahead of that merge base. None of them touches a file in this PR (the one `packages/rest` change is `record-page-routes.ts` and its test), no commit there names the route, and `git merge-tree` reports a clean merge, so the branch was not merged again.
